explain.headline: $539/mo short, cash runs out May 2028
explain.summary: Even with every change, interest and new card charges add more than you can pay: the debt grows about $175/mo until the gap closes.
explain.driver: They keep charging on the cards while paying them down, so balances barely move.
explain.buffer_why: Steady income; buffer size changes nothing here.
downsides: Retirement contributions continue despite negative cash flow

cuts.how: Cut back on Walmart and Amazon household; Keep household & other under $227/mo
Cut back on Starbucks and Whataburger; Keep dining & delivery under $203/mo

underwater_options.title: Pause IRA contributions
underwater_options.detail: Stop the monthly IRA deposit until the gap closes.
underwater_options.how: Lower or pause the contribution at your IRA provider.
underwater_options.why: Stops retirement deposits to cover the full monthly shortfall.
underwater_options.downside: Lost retirement growth and compounding for as long as paused.

underwater_options.title: Income-driven repayment
underwater_options.detail: Ask the federal loan servicer for an income-driven plan.
underwater_options.how: Apply for an income-driven repayment plan; it takes about 10 minutes with your FSA ID.
underwater_options.why: Lowers the federal student loan payment right away.
underwater_options.downside: More interest over time and a longer payoff.

underwater_options.title: Card hardship program
underwater_options.detail: Ask each card issuer for a hardship rate (often about 9.9%).
underwater_options.how: Call the number on the back of each card and ask for their hardship program.
underwater_options.why: Lowers credit card rates and monthly payments.
underwater_options.downside: Card access may close and credit could dip.

underwater_options.title: Ask the mortgage lender for help
underwater_options.detail: A loan modification, forbearance or refinance can lower the payment; the lender decides.
underwater_options.how: Call your servicer and ask about a loan modification or forbearance; a HUD counselor is free.

underwater_options.title: Sell or downsize the home
underwater_options.detail: Frees the largest payment; a big life decision with selling costs.
underwater_options.how: Talk to a real-estate agent about selling costs before deciding.

underwater_options.title: Earn more each month
underwater_options.detail: A room rental, extra hours or side work; hard to count on, so not modelled.
underwater_options.how: Only count it once it's steady.

underwater_options.title: Withdraw from the IRA
underwater_options.detail: Last resort: taxes plus a 10% penalty before 59½, and lost retirement growth.
underwater_options.how: Last resort: ask your IRA provider about the taxes and 10% penalty first.

underwater_not_helping.title: Smaller cash cushion
underwater_not_helping.why: cash is already draining each month, so there's none spare to put on the debt
